title: Change invoice numbering?
description: New invoices will use the new format from now on.

impact.suffix_one: invoice already issued keeps its existing numbers — nothing is renumbered, and no number is ever reused.
impact.suffix_other: invoices already issued keep their existing numbers — nothing is renumbered, and no number is ever reused.
impact.none: This institute has not issued any invoices yet, so nothing is affected by the change.

warning.text: This format produces numbers that are not strictly sequential. Many tax authorities require invoice numbers to run in an unbroken sequence — check with your accountant before saving.

checkbox.label: I understand that invoices created from now on will use the new format.
